issue.title: Plain git-file history provider for plans, skills, xprompts, and research docs on the pager history seam

task_type_fields.proposal: Register a second sase_pager_history provider, alongside sase.memory.history.pager_provider, that gives plain git-tracked documents (plans, skills, xprompts, research docs) the same ( ) { } = @ time axis. It would reuse sase-core file_history and prose_diff without the memory-specific subject semantics.
